v01.summary: Added rules to prevent incorrect database changes by clarifying order/item contradictions and excluding lost items from returns, and improved logic for handling 'keep everything the same' constraints.

v02.summary: Added rules to ensure correct confirmation of updated details, fulfill policy-mandated reminders, call necessary tools for cheapest options, and correctly explain return logistics to prevent unnecessary transfers.

v03.summary: Improved tool-calling flow for product lookups, corrected cheapest-option logic to include availability checks, and added stricter requirement filtering and multi-order exchange logic.

v04.summary: Improved order identification for category/description requests, clarified the order of operations for concurrent return/exchange requests, and refined variant selection and availability counting.

v05.summary: Improved order identification for category/description requests, clarified the order of operations for concurrent return/exchange requests, and refined variant selection and availability counting.

v06.summary: Added rules to ensure skills are loaded before proposals, all tool calls are completed before multi-request responses, specific sequences for return/exchange are followed, and users are warned about status changes from partial modifications.

v07.summary: Improved order modification logic by requiring explicit confirmation for multiple changes, checking if modifications are already completed, clarifying ambiguous items, and restricting variant proposals to the original matching attribute.

v08.summary: Added systemic rules to ensure all orders are checked, skills are loaded immediately, success messages follow tool calls, and all possible actions are completed before transfer.

v09.summary: Add rules to improve skill loading, ensure explicit 'yes' confirmation, and improve order identification.
